summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K announcing it will release third-quarter 2026 financial results and hold a conference call on November 2, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, with fourth-quarter 2026 guidance. The filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. The call will be webcast via the Investor Relations website, requires pre-registration for dial-in, and will be available for replay for 90 days. No risk-arb angle applies.
